notes: The Odds API's own monogram: TOA on its white rounded tile, the site's SVG favicon, unchanged. It replaces the THE ODDS-API wordmark (assets/img/logo.svg). The Odds API publishes no mark drawn as paths: like its logo, the favicon sets the letters as <text> in 'Courier New' bold, so they draw in that font (or Courier Prime, Courier, monospace) on the viewer's machine. The tile is the brand's own; it reads on both themes, so one file serves both.
license: The Odds API brand mark, used nominatively to identify the service. Trademark rights remain with The Odds API.
